name: auditory
description: Measures the level of noise, echoes, background sounds, and overall sound environment.

name: visual
description: Measures the visual environment, including lighting, brightness, glare, colours, and visual distractions.

name: legibility
description: Measures how easy the environment is to read and understand, including clear signage, layout predictability, and wayfinding.

name: safety_feeling
description: Measures how safe, secure, and comfortable users feel within the space, considering visibility, accessibility, and overall atmosphere.

name: predictability
description: Measures how consistent and easy the environment is to understand and navigate, including clear layouts, signage, and routine levels.

name: olfactory
description: Measures the presence and intensity of smells or odors that may affect comfort or sensory experience.

name: tactile
description: Measures physical sensations from surfaces and materials, including seating comfort, textures, vibrations, and touch-related experiences.

name: thermal
description: Measures temperature and overall thermal comfort, including heating, cooling, and ventilation.

name: vestibular
description: Measures factors that may affect balance or spatial orientation, such as stairs, ramps, elevators, uneven flooring, or movement within the space.
